trigger: End of billing cycle or customer request for invoice
current_workaround: Manually generate PDF invoices using a template and send via email
consequence: Time lost (2+ hours/month), delayed payments, customer frustration if invoices are late

workflow: Manual categorization of customer support tickets
trigger: Incoming support email or chat message
current_workaround: Read each ticket, manually assign a category label in the helpdesk
consequence: Inconsistent tagging, difficulty reporting on common issues, wasted time (15-30 min/day)

workflow: Manual formatting and scheduling of newsletter content
current_workaround: Copy blog post HTML into email editor, adjust formatting, schedule send
consequence: 30+ minutes per week, risk of broken formatting, inconsistent branding

target_role: Indie hacker running an affiliate program
workflow: Manual tracking of affiliate referrals and commissions
current_workaround: Use a spreadsheet to record affiliate links, sales, and calculate commissions
consequence: Errors in commission payouts, time spent reconciling, difficulty scaling

workflow: Manual churn analysis from payment data
current_workaround: Export Stripe subscription data to Excel, manually calculate churn rate and cohort retention
consequence: Delayed insights, potential miscalculations, inability to react quickly to churn trends
